next.reason: 1985: 'Report-name-1 is the highest permissible qualifier that may be specified for LINE-COUNTER, PAGE-COUNTER, and all data-names defined within the Report Section.' 2023: report counters take only 'IN/OF report-name-1' (§2023:8.4.3.15.2); a qualified data-name is 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] ... [ file-report-qualifier ]' (§2023:8.4.2.2.2), the data-qualifiers being successively more inclusive levels (§2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR4) and the single report-name last. Same ceiling, same refusals. SR9 and SR10 say when qualification is required, not this ceiling.
